source.title: Disenqueue v1.1.2 Retail processing queue implementation: shared five-item stack threshold and spellcast completion handling
source.author: Grimmsforge

notes: NEW SOURCE INTEGRITY FINDING ONLY; zero new player operations or measured yields. Public Retail addon hardcodes MIN_STACK_SIZE=5 for both prospecting and milling (Core.lua lines 17-23, 279-303), retains milling queue while 5+ remain (675-699), and its progress counter measures queue entries (725-735), not total successful mills. Midnight Milling is documented to require 10 herbs per cast (research/v3/mechanics.md M6; Blizzard forum 2307840). An automatically queued 5-9-herb stack must not be inferred to be a completed Midnight mill. The addon registers UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED, but no output-count, zero-event or refund ledger was provided. Documentation explicitly claims 5+ milling for mixed expansions. This is an untested source-code / recipe contract mismatch, NOT proof of live-client behavior or a new independent study. Do not manufacture casts or treat attempted keypresses/queue progress as denominator; if a consented addon export becomes available, demand actual completed spell event + output+input counts.
lookingFor: Original current-Retail completed milling event logs for Tranquility Bloom 236761 to Powder Pigment 245807, and whether Disenqueue's 5-item queue threshold yields valid 10-herb Midnight operations
